# sqldol

> sql (through sqlalchemy) with a simple (dict-like or list-like) interface


## Pages in this subsection

- [sqldol](sqldol.html.md): sql with a simple (dict-like or list-like) interface
- [sqldol.access](sqldol.access.html.md): Read Microsoft Access files (&#96;.mdb&#96;, &#96;.accdb&#96;: Jet3, Jet4, ACE) as Mappings and as engines.
- [sqldol.base](sqldol.base.html.md): Base objects for sqldol
- [sqldol.ops](sqldol.ops.html.md): Leaf-level operations, as free functions over the caller’s (possibly wrapped) store.
- [sqldol.sql_base](sqldol.sql_base.html.md): Independent legacy DOLs
- [sqldol.stores](sqldol.stores.html.md): Higher level stores for sql data
- [sqldol.util](sqldol.util.html.md): Utils for sqldol
